incomplete_policy: incomplete scans are predicted indeterminate unless a dynamic rule already fired, and are counted in coverage rather than dropped
precedence: first matching rule wins; R6 always matches last

reason_codes.baseline-failed: the native baseline did not satisfy
reason_codes.kb-no-coverage: kb has no verified release coverage
reason_codes.no-image-digest: input has no oci manifest digest

rules.when: any finding with severity hard-failure (schema forces a dynamic runsc/kata tier)
dynamic.fallback_observations is non-empty and no R1-R3 finding exists
status complete, dynamic tier is runsc/kata diff, no findings above compatibility-risk
none of the above, including every incomplete or static-only report
